name: ballerina/log
description: This module provides APIs to log information when running applications, with support for contextual logging, configurable log levels, formats, destinations, and key-value context.

typeDefs.name: JSON_FORMAT
typeDefs.description: The JSON log format.

typeDefs.name: LOGFMT
typeDefs.description: The Logfmt log format.

typeDefs.name: STDERR
typeDefs.description: Standard error output as the destination

typeDefs.name: STDOUT
typeDefs.description: Standard output as the destination

typeDefs.name: FILE
typeDefs.description: File output as the destination

typeDefs.name: TRUNCATE
typeDefs.description:
Truncates the file before writing. This mode creates a new file if one doesn't exist.
If the file already exists, its contents are cleared, and new data is written
from the beginning.

typeDefs.name: APPEND
typeDefs.description:
Appends to the existing content. This mode creates a new file if one doesn't exist.
If the file already exists, new data is appended to the end of its current contents.

typeDefs.name: SIZE_BASED
typeDefs.description: Rotate logs based on file size only

typeDefs.name: TIME_BASED
typeDefs.description: Rotate logs based on time only

typeDefs.name: BOTH
typeDefs.description: Rotate logs based on both file size and time (whichever condition is met first)

typeDefs.name: EXCLUDE
typeDefs.description: Exclude the field from log output

typeDefs.name: Error
typeDefs.description: Represents errors specific to the Log module.

typeDefs.name: Logger
typeDefs.description: Logger object type defines an interface for logging messages

typeDefs.name: Level
typeDefs.description: Log level types.

typeDefs.name: Valuer
typeDefs.description:
A function that returns a value of type `anydata`.
Useful in scenarios where computation is required to retrieve the value.
This function is executed only if the specific log level is enabled.

typeDefs.name: PrintableRawTemplate
typeDefs.description:
Raw templates for logging.

e.g: `The input value is ${val}`

typeDefs.name: Value
typeDefs.description: A value that can be of type `anydata`, a function pointer, or a raw template.

typeDefs.name: RotationConfig
typeDefs.description: Log rotation configuration for file destinations.

fields.name: policy
fields.description: Rotation policy to use

fields.name: maxFileSize
fields.description:
Maximum file size in bytes before rotation (used with SIZE_BASED or BOTH policies)
Default: 10MB (10 * 1024 * 1024 bytes)

fields.name: maxAge
fields.description:
Maximum age in seconds before rotation (used with TIME_BASED or BOTH policies)
Default: 24 hours (24 * 60 * 60 seconds)

fields.name: maxBackupFiles
fields.description:
Maximum number of backup files to retain. Older files are deleted.
Default: 10 backup files

typeDefs.name: Config
typeDefs.description: Configuration for the Ballerina logger

fields.name: id
fields.description:
Optional unique identifier for this logger.
All loggers are registered and can be discovered via `getLoggerRegistry()`.
If provided, this value is used as the logger's runtime ID (prefixed with the module name);
otherwise, an ID is auto-generated from the calling context.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Log format to use. Default is the logger format configured in the module level

fields.name: level
fields.description: Log level to use. Default is the logger level configured in the module level

fields.name: destinations
fields.description: List of destinations to log to. Default is the logger destinations configured in the module level

fields.name: keyValues
fields.description: Additional key-value pairs to include in the log messages. Default is the key-values configured in the module level

fields.name: enableSensitiveDataMasking
fields.description: Enable sensitive data masking. Default is the module level configuration

typeDefs.name: LoggerRegistry
typeDefs.description: Provides access to the logger registry for discovering and managing registered loggers.

typeDefs.name: ReplacementFunction
typeDefs.description: Replacement function type for sensitive data masking

typeDefs.name: Replacement
typeDefs.description: Replacement strategy for sensitive data

fields.name: replacement
fields.description:
The replacement value. This can be a string which will be used to replace the
entire value, or a function that takes the original value and returns a masked version.

typeDefs.name: MaskingStrategy
typeDefs.description: Masking strategy for sensitive data

typeDefs.name: SensitiveConfig
typeDefs.description: Represents sensitive data with a masking strategy

fields.name: strategy
fields.description: The masking strategy to apply

Returns a masked string representation of the given data based on the sensitive data masking annotation.
This method panics if a cyclic value reference is encountered.
